# Finding-triggered craft correction

This is a narrow adapter, not the Impeccable operating system. Activate only after 07 records one of:

`GENERIC | FLAT | SAFE | OVERDESIGNED | WEAK_HIERARCHY | INTERCHANGEABLE`.

04 selects one correction lens matching the cause:

- `bolder` for timid hierarchy or insufficient visual authority;
- `quieter` for competing signals or overstimulation;
- `distill` for unnecessary structure;
- `typeset` for weak typographic voice;
- `layout` for conventional or interchangeable composition.

Apply one batched correction to the cited scenes while preserving content truth and the selected genome. 07 then performs one isolated re-review. Do not initialize Impeccable's `PRODUCT.md`, `DESIGN.md`, routing or parallel review system.
